title: BackpackUI!
description: Persistent backpack system with global inventory management for administrators.
body:
# BackpackUI Description

BackpackUI is a lightweight Paper plugin that gives every player a persistent personal backpack.
It focuses on fast access, reliable save behavior, and simple moderation tools for server staff.

## Core Features
- Personal backpack inventory with persistent storage
- Quick access via `/backpack` or `/bp`
- Admin inspection using `/backpack view <Name>`
- Backpack cleanup via `/backpack clear [Name]`
- Automatic save on inventory close and plugin shutdown

## Use Case
BackpackUI is ideal for survival and event servers where players need extra item space without introducing complex economy or GUI systems.
